label: late copy-phase steps (3rd output onward), strongest for short sequences and near the end
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only from the third output on (recall_idx >= 2; 99.7% of activation mass). It never fires on original-phase or delimiter steps, or when outputting tokens 0 or 1. Within that region it is sparse (about 14% of steps). It is most likely in short sequences (L=3,4: about 43% of mass, 61% precision) and on the last two outputs (to_go <= 1: 82% of mass). The largest activations are on the final output step of L=3 sequences, especially when the input token there is a digit (0 or 2). In longer sequences it also leans toward particular input tokens (0, 2, z, 1, h, p, s, a). This token dependence is only partly captured, so precision stays near 0.5.
